The International Court of Justice has ruled that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya minority, in an unprecedented verdict over a 2017 military crackdown that killed thousands. Analysts say the ruling, brought by The Gambia, could have far-reaching implications. In markets, a tech stock sell-off dragged US shares lower, with Anthropic shares sliding and both the S and P 500 and the Dow Jones Industrial Average pushed into correction territory. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has called Vladimir Putin a killer, after Donald Trump greeted the Russian leader ahead of a meeting in China and said the two have a great relationship. In the Middle East, a Saudi-led coalition intercepted three Houthi missiles headed for Riyadh. Saudi Arabia issued emergency alerts in the capital for a third night in a row, as the Houthis threaten ports and a power station. And Denmark has accused Russia of plotting to assassinate a US-Ukrainian rapper. Russia's embassy denied the allegation, but Russia's defence attaché has been expelled. That's International News for today. Thank you for listening.

item.description:

今天是二零二六年十一月二十一日，歡迎收聽 AI 科技新聞。首先關注輝達。前執行長黃仁勳因一段婚外情而辭職，此事可能牽涉美國國家安全，尤其在美中競逐最先進 AI 基礎設施的背景下更受矚目。輝達本週在代理執行長克蕾斯帶領下公布第三季財報，成長依然穩健，並承諾好光景會持續，但同時宣布將停止在中國銷售 H200 晶片。不過股價表現疲弱，週四徘徊在每股一百五十美元左右，比十月六日的歷史高點下跌將近四成。接著是數學界的大消息。Anthropic 的數學家阿爾佩格宣稱，他在 Claude 協助下證明了黎曼猜想，這是千禧年大獎難題之一，困擾數學家長達一百六十七年。如果獲得驗證，將是 AI 在數學領域又一項重大突破，而且同時也出現了一個由人類提出的競爭解法，讓數學家們大感震撼。同樣和 Anthropic 有關，該公司完成創紀錄的首次公開發行，以調升後每股八十三美元定價，募得將近一千零五十億美元，七位創辦人每人入袋兩億八千萬美元，合計接近二十億美元。政策方面，美國總統川普揚言，將對在美國境外興建資料中心的企業課徵所謂的巨額稅，他表示不會允許美國企業在國外蓋資料中心，然而美國各地已有州和城市開始限制新的資料中心申請案。最後，通訊軟體 Signal 宣布限制在安卓和 iOS 裝置上截圖，目的是防止作業系統內建的 AI 代理，例如 Gemini 和 Siri，讀取使用者的訊息與資料。Signal 認為，這類分析螢幕內容的代理功能，正在削弱它獨立保障使用者隱私的能力。以上就是今天的 AI 科技新聞，感謝收聽，我們明天見。

Analysts say it is a remarkable diplomatic moment for Xi, though it comes with pitfalls. Meanwhile, Putin has vowed a far more painful response to Ukraine's strikes on the Crimean Bridge. That's International News for today.

That comes not long after it raised 122 billion dollars in March at an 852 billion dollar valuation, while rival Anthropic nears its IPO.
